svg.text: Encoder(L layers) = L blocks, then final LayerNorm
B State encoder: chunk-parallel, run once per request
text → BPE ids (CLS + tokens), N tokens, no truncation inside the model
M only if keep_tokens (off by default)
Global Encoder (G layers) over n_c·m latents, RoPE θ_g = 160k
B batch · N tokens · d width
m latents per chunk (16): compression C/m
Q questions · K options · +1 unknown slot
H head layers · G global layers · L local layers
Head: O(Q·(K+1)·|h|·d), h shared, never copied
Why chunking: attention FLOPs/token grow with N,
so 32k dense costs more than the matmuls.
Costs are derived from FLOPs, not measured
D Question encoder (same encoder, same embeddings)
E Decision head: late interaction over the cached state
② cross-attention to h (h shared, not copied)
score: E[level] = Σ j·p_j / Σ p_j
G Training stages (one model, plain step functions)
unknown slot is a label (y = K)
